title: The same failure seen from the Central Bank: unexplained is non-zero, balanced false
description: BCCR's reconciliation shows 5.43 W-tCeBM_CRC on chain that no in-flight payment accounts for, flagged against the payer bank and the stranded RESIDUE position from mock-amm-res-01. This is the supervisory counterpart of the client-side symptom.
notes: Gateway: BCCR Central Bank gateway. A non-zero unexplained is a reportable condition, not necessarily a loss. bridge_state RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED is part of the real bridge vocabulary recovered from Go domain code (LOCKING, ACTIVE, BURNING, BURNED, RELEASED, RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED); it is absent from the platform OpenAPI document entirely, and the PENDING/ACTIVE/CLOSED example that document gives names two states that do not exist.
